solver.interface_finding_2026_09_02: Upstream source review found NO machine-facing interface (no HTTP listener, pipe, socket or file watcher). Consumption paths are: game diagnostic logs ([CombatSolver/Test] blocks in {game user data}/logs/*.log), manually exported problem packages (Desktop CombatSolver-BugReports/*.zip, includes combat-solver/combat-state.json + current-route.txt + forensics), and the settings file user://combat_solver_settings.json (Godot user:// maps to %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\<game>\ on Windows). Candidate routes are in-memory only and reach disk solely inside problem packages.
solver.log_grammar: v1 (calibrated 2026-09-02 against godot.log of CombatSolver 0.25.3): SEARCH_REQUEST generation=N turn=T opens a block; ACTION turn=K kind=PlayCard|UsePotion|EndTurn card_id=/potion_id= target_index=; RESULT ... reused= searched_turns= battle_hp_lost_so_far= projected_battle_hp_lost= total_elapsed_ms= expanded= total_worker_allocated_bytes= final_hp= combat_ended_turn=; TURN_OUTCOME turn=K hp_lost=; SEARCH_FAILURE generation=N exception=; SEARCH_STALE generation=N.
